description: This Java class 'DevStripActionProvider' implements a UI component that provides a clickable action view, which when clicked, launches the developer tools activity via an intent. It is part of the 'com.anysoftkeyboard.ui.dev' package and interacts with Android framework classes and other components of the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: DevStripActionProvider
classes.description: A class that provides a UI component for a developer tools action, inflating a view and handling click events to launch developer tools.
